rule: An Entra ID app registration counts as the platform Azure identity when Gazelle names it in configuration files.

links.note: The app registration exists inside the Gazelle tenant, so no Entra ID app registration can carry platform Azure identity status until Gazelle exists.

violations: Platform deployment authenticates through a managed identity.
Platform Azure identity is configured outside Gazelle configuration files.
Platform Azure identity is shared with non-platform workloads.
